content.short: Openlaunch is a permissionless DEX and safety-first launchpad with locked liquidity and no admin backdoors.
content.description: Openlaunch combines a permissionless DEX with a launchpad built around transparency: no hidden mints, no admin backdoors, and liquidity locked permanently and verifiably. Those are exactly the mechanisms most token launch scams rely on, so ruling them out at the contract level is the point. It operates on Stable.
